name: gilded_leaves
description: translucent gilded-glass leaf blades on dark crackled stone: almond blades bright at the spine, fading towards their tips, sweeping in sprays and spirals, small bright copies inlaid along each, overlaps glowing, the smaller blades faint grey ghosts

reference.made_with: a fractal flame by its look (signed exoteric.roach.org), 2560x1600

reuses: shaded_blades' strip shape of the bubble trap (lines 1 apart at tilt 0, the critical point midway between, escaped only): each entry pulls back as a pointed, curved blade
the entry's height to a high power as a glow: power 5 is a translucent body, power 14 the bright spine, so a blade is an almond core fading to its edges
a palette layer by rank on the entry step, masked to the body: one gold, bronze or cream per blade (the map's 0.65 to 0.86)
largest and smallest: gold blades between 0.14 and 0.014 frames, ghost blades from 0.021 down to 0.00175 in the map's grey, so depth reads by size and brightness
hits 1 and 2 laid additively, and hit 3 inside as a cream spine: blades inside blades

064's stripe grain, unmasked and at low contrast (frost_stipple's pale screens at 256 and 64, grain_fans' dark multiply, here at 32), over a smooth-count ground by rank in the map's charcoal: the crackled stone
the tone pass with log density (k 8), at the reference's median and p10
adds: bubble member fade (a share): the entry's height thins to 0 from (1 - fade)·largest up to largest and from (1 + fade)·smallest down to smallest, as the stroke trap thins its strokes. Unfaded, a sample whose large entry `largest` passed over reads the next entry and meets its neighbour at a seam; faded, blades come and go softly and summed hits draw each blade whole
notes: Round one (item 066). Matt's direction (amendment 2466) was existing traps first, mapped cleverly to colour and alpha. Which mapping carried each part: **the blade** is the strip trap's entry (shaded_blades' shape), pointed and curved where a strip pulls back through each critical point; **almond, bright at the spine** is the entry's height to a power (5 for the translucent body, 14 for the spine), since the height is 1 on the strip's line and the blade narrows to its tips; **gold with copper and rose hints** is a rank palette on the entry step over the map's bronze-to-gold run, masked by the body; **depth** is size: gold between 0.14 and 0.014 frames, grey ghosts below; **detail inside** is the next hit (a blade inside each blade) plus the ghost sizes inlaid in cream, masked to the gold body; **overlaps glow** is every layer `add` with the tone pass's log density; **the stone** is 064's stripe grain at low contrast. One primitive: the bubble's `fade`, because an entry read stops all at once at `largest`, drawing seams across every spray (the `p_nofade` reading shows them).

What did not carry: the stroke trap at taper 0.85 to 1 (the plane line trap, nearest over the steps) draws lace hugging the set, since near the set many steps' curves are in bounds; the disc lattice's crescent lunes read as moons, not leaves; strip entries at a low power flood the frame, because with `spacing` nearly every escaping sample enters some blade. A second tilt (the `p_crossed` reading) makes every blade a cross; one tilt gives sprays.

Round one's readings: the tone pass holds 10 of 16 location drafts; the six misses are p90 high (0.44 to 0.54 against 0.309) on the densest sprays. The `p_dim` reading (spine opacity 0.7 to 0.4, a stronger grain) moves p90 down about 0.04 at both formulation seats, bringing one into the band; the tinted body (opacity 0.8) is the rest. The module drew a 640x400 frame in 129 s on a loaded box, over the explorer bar at 1280x800: the stack ran seven bubble loops, the two `step` reads carrying no `fade` while their masks did, so each was a loop of its own; item 067 gave each the same `fade` (the fade weights the height alone, so the output is unchanged) and the stack runs five. That bought no measurable time: paired at the Julia spiral keep's seat on a quiet box, the module drew 640x400 ss2 in 39.5 s before and 41.1 s after (native identical bytes), so the 129 s was the loaded box and its seat, and merging loops is not where the cost is. Round one named dropping the summed second hit as the other lever. Matt kept spine opacities 0.7 (the stack, p_large), 0.5 (p_crossed) and 0.4 (p_dim), so the default stays 0.7. Locations: phoenix and Julia spiral seats give the sprays; plain seats scatter the blades.

Explorer cost (080, `style cost`, read beside other Node workers: an upper bound): 260 s as WebAssembly on one thread at 1280x800 ss2 at its deepest kept seat (phoenix_d4ce71a6, maxiter 14,307), under the 5-minute bar.
